pages.en: Lily loves drawing. One day Mia says, "Come and join our art club! We meet every Tuesday after school." Lily is very happy.
pages.zh: Lily 很喜欢画画。有一天 Mia 说：“来加入我们的美术社吧！我们每周二放学后活动。”Lily 非常高兴。

pages.en: At the club, every member paints a picture for the school festival. Lily paints Max in the park. Mia paints a big red boat.
pages.zh: 在社团里，每个成员都要为学校艺术节画一幅画。Lily 画了在公园里的 Max，Mia 画了一艘红色的大船。

pages.en: At the festival, lots of people look at the pictures. Mum and Dad come too. "Your picture is wonderful!" says Dad. Lily wants to paint every day now.
pages.zh: 艺术节上，很多人来看画。妈妈和爸爸也来了。“你的画太棒了！”爸爸说。现在 Lily 想每天都画画。

questions.q: The art club meets on Tuesday.
Mum and Dad don't come to the festival.
questions.zh: 妈妈和爸爸没来艺术节。

pages.en: One hot morning, Mum opens the fridge. The milk is warm and the light does not come on. "Oh no! The fridge is broken," she says.
pages.zh: 一个炎热的早上，妈妈打开冰箱。牛奶是温的，灯也不亮。“哎呀！冰箱坏了，”她说。

pages.en: Dad looks at the lamp and the radio. Nothing works! "There is no electricity in the house," he says.
pages.zh: 爸爸看了看台灯和收音机。都不工作！“家里停电了，”他说。

pages.en: Lily and Tom put the food in a cool bag. At lunchtime the lights come on again, and the fridge works again. "Yes!" shouts Tom.
pages.zh: Lily 和 Tom 把食物放进保温袋。到了中午，灯又亮了，冰箱也重新工作了。“太好了！”Tom 大喊。

questions.q: The fridge is broken because there is no electricity.
questions.zh: 冰箱坏了，是因为停电了。

questions.q: What does Dad look at first?
The lights come on again in the evening.

pages.en: Mum has lots to do in town today. First she takes Lily and Tom to the dentist. Their teeth are fine!
pages.zh: 妈妈今天在城里有很多事要办。她先带 Lily 和 Tom 去看牙医。他们的牙齿都很好！

pages.en: Then they go to the post office with a present for Grandma, and to the library for some new books.
pages.zh: 然后他们去邮局给奶奶寄礼物，又去图书馆借了几本新书。

pages.en: At last they have lunch at a restaurant. "What a busy day!" says Tom. "Now let's go to the swimming pool!"
pages.zh: 最后他们在一家餐馆吃午饭。“今天真忙啊！”Tom 说，“现在我们去游泳池吧！”

questions.q: They send a present to Grandpa.
They have lunch at a restaurant.

pages.en: At eight o'clock in the morning, Lily wakes up. Today is Saturday, so there is no school. At half past nine, she has her swimming lesson with Dad.
pages.zh: 早上八点，Lily 醒了。今天是星期六，不用上学。九点半，她和爸爸去上游泳课。

pages.en: In the afternoon, Lily and Mia make a cake with Grandma. It takes one hour. Tom wants to eat it now, but Grandma says, "Wait a minute!"
pages.zh: 下午，Lily 和 Mia 跟奶奶一起做蛋糕，花了一个小时。Tom 现在就想吃，可是奶奶说：“等一会儿！”

pages.en: In the evening, the family eats the cake after dinner. At nine o'clock, Lily goes to bed. "What a busy day!" she says. "See you tomorrow!"
pages.zh: 晚上，一家人吃完晚饭后吃蛋糕。九点钟，Lily 上床睡觉。“真是忙碌的一天！”她说，“明天见！”

questions.q: Lily has a swimming lesson on Saturday morning.
questions.zh: Lily 星期六上午有游泳课。

questions.q: Who makes the cake with Lily?
questions.zh: 谁和 Lily 一起做蛋糕？

questions.q: Lily goes to bed at eight o'clock.

pages.en: It is the first of December. Tom looks at the calendar on the kitchen wall. "When is my birthday, Mum?" he asks. "In two weeks," says Mum.
pages.zh: 今天是十二月一日。Tom 看着厨房墙上的日历。“妈妈，我的生日是什么时候？”他问。“还有两个星期，”妈妈说。

pages.en: Every day, Tom draws a small star on the calendar. Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday… A week is very long! "Is it my birthday yet?" he asks every morning.
pages.zh: 每天，Tom 都在日历上画一颗小星星。星期一、星期二、星期三……一个星期好长啊！“到我生日了吗？”他每天早上都问。

pages.en: At last, the day comes. Tom is seven! There is a big cake, and Sam and Grandpa come to the party. "This is the best day of the year!" says Tom.
pages.zh: 终于，那一天到了。Tom 七岁了！有一个大蛋糕，Sam 和爷爷都来参加派对。“这是一年里最棒的一天！”Tom 说。

questions.q: What does Tom draw on the calendar every day?
questions.zh: Tom 每天在日历上画什么？

questions.q: Tom is six on his birthday.

pages.en: In the summer holiday, Lily's family goes camping. They find a campsite next to a lake. Dad and Sam put up the big green tent.
pages.zh: 暑假里，Lily 一家去露营。他们在湖边找到一个营地。爸爸和 Sam 搭起了绿色的大帐篷。

pages.en: In the evening, they have a barbecue. Grandpa cooks fish and Lily takes photos with her camera. Then Sam plays the guitar and everyone sings.
pages.zh: 傍晚，他们吃烧烤。爷爷烤鱼，Lily 用相机拍照。然后 Sam 弹吉他，大家一起唱歌。

pages.en: At night, Lily and Tom lie in the tent. They can hear the water and the birds. "Camping is great," says Tom. "Can we come again next year?"
pages.zh: 夜里，Lily 和 Tom 躺在帐篷里。他们能听见水声和鸟叫。“露营真棒，”Tom 说，“我们明年还能再来吗？”

questions.q: The campsite is next to a lake.

pages.en: Lily's class is doing a project about animals. Lily and Mia want to learn about penguins, so they go to the school library.
pages.zh: Lily 的班级在做一个关于动物的课题。Lily 和 Mia 想了解企鹅，于是她们去了学校图书馆。

pages.en: They find a big book with lots of information. Penguins can't fly, but they can swim very fast. Mia draws a penguin and Lily writes the notes.
pages.zh: 她们找到一本有很多资料的大书。企鹅不会飞，但游得非常快。Mia 画了一只企鹅，Lily 做笔记。

pages.en: On Thursday, they show their project to the class. Everyone likes the penguin picture. "Very good work!" says the teacher.
pages.zh: 星期四，她们向全班展示课题。大家都喜欢那幅企鹅画。“做得非常好！”老师说。

questions.zh: 这个课题是关于企鹅的。

questions.q: Where do Lily and Mia find the book?
questions.zh: Lily 和 Mia 在哪里找到那本书？

pages.en: Grandpa has a farm with twenty sheep. One evening he says, "Lily, how many sheep are in the field?"
pages.zh: 爷爷有一个农场，养了二十只羊。一天傍晚，他说：“Lily，田里有几只羊？”

pages.en: "One, two, three ... nineteen," says Lily. She looks again. "Nineteen! One sheep is not here!"
pages.zh: “一、二、三……十九，”Lily 说。她又看了一遍。“十九只！少了一只羊！”

pages.en: Max runs up the hill. There is the twentieth sheep, with a baby sheep! "Now we have one more!" laughs Grandpa.
pages.zh: Max 跑上小山。第二十只羊就在那儿，身边还有一只小羊！“现在我们又多了一只！”爷爷笑着说。

questions.q: How many sheep does Grandpa have at first?
questions.zh: 爷爷一开始有多少只羊？
是 Tom 找到了那只羊。

pages.en: Lily has a toothache. "Too many sweets!" says Mum. They make an appointment with the dentist for Monday afternoon.
pages.zh: Lily 牙疼了。“糖吃太多了！”妈妈说。她们约了星期一下午看牙医。

pages.en: Lily is a little afraid, but the dentist is very kind. He looks at her teeth and fixes the bad tooth. It doesn't hurt much.
pages.zh: Lily 有点害怕，可是牙医很和蔼。他看了她的牙，把坏牙补好了。不怎么疼。

pages.en: At home, Lily gives Tom a new toothbrush. "Brush your teeth twice a day," she says, "and don't eat too many sweets!" Tom laughs.
pages.zh: 回到家，Lily 给了 Tom 一把新牙刷。“每天刷两次牙，”她说，“别吃太多糖！”Tom 笑了。

questions.q: Lily's toothache is from too many sweets.
questions.zh: Lily 牙疼是因为吃了太多糖。
Lily 给了 Tom 什么？

pages.en: On Friday, the family has a film night at home. Tom wants a cartoon, but Lily wants an adventure film.
pages.zh: 星期五，一家人在家里过电影之夜。Tom 想看动画片，可是 Lily 想看冒险片。

pages.en: "Let's watch both!" says Dad. First they watch a funny cartoon. Everyone laughs, and Max jumps up at the television.
pages.zh: “两部都看吧！”爸爸说。他们先看了一部搞笑的动画片。大家都笑了，Max 对着电视跳了起来。

pages.en: Then they watch the adventure film. It is long, and at the end Tom is sleeping on the sofa. "Good night, Tom," says Mum.
pages.zh: 接着他们看那部冒险片。片子很长，看到最后，Tom 已经在沙发上睡着了。“晚安，Tom，”妈妈说。

questions.q: The family goes to the cinema.
Tom is sleeping at the end.

pages.en: Tom can't swim, so Dad takes him to the swimming pool on Saturday. Tom is a bit afraid of the water.
pages.zh: Tom 不会游泳，所以星期六爸爸带他去游泳池。Tom 有点怕水。

pages.en: The coach is very kind. She helps Tom. First he kicks his legs, and then he moves his arms.
pages.zh: 教练很和气，她帮助 Tom。他先踢腿，然后划手臂。

pages.en: After five lessons, Tom can swim! He swims to Dad without help. "I'm a fish!" he laughs.
pages.zh: 上了五节课后，Tom 会游泳了！他不用别人帮忙就游到了爸爸身边。“我是一条鱼！”他笑着说。

questions.q: Tom can swim at the start of the story.
questions.zh: 故事开始时 Tom 会游泳。

questions.q: Who helps Tom in the pool?

pages.en: There is a big tree in Lily's garden. In spring, it has small green leaves and pink flowers. Birds sing in it.
pages.zh: Lily 的花园里有一棵大树。春天，树上长出小小的绿叶和粉红色的花，鸟儿在树上唱歌。

pages.en: In summer, the tree is green and the family has lunch under it. In autumn, the leaves are red and brown, and Tom plays in them.
pages.zh: 夏天，树绿油油的，一家人在树下吃午饭。秋天，树叶变成了红色和棕色，Tom 在落叶里玩。

pages.en: In winter, there are no leaves, and there is snow on the tree. Lily and Tom play in the snow under it. "I love my tree in every season!" says Lily.
pages.zh: 冬天，树叶掉光了，树上积着雪。Lily 和 Tom 在树下玩雪。“我每个季节都爱我的树！”Lily 说。

questions.q: The tree has pink flowers in spring.
questions.zh: 春天树上开着粉红色的花。

questions.q: What do Lily and Tom do in winter?
questions.zh: 冬天 Lily 和 Tom 做什么？

questions.q: The leaves are green in autumn.

pages.en: Today is Grandma's birthday. The whole family comes to her house: Mum, Dad, Lily, Tom, Aunt Kate, Uncle Ben and cousin Sam.
pages.zh: 今天是奶奶的生日。全家人都来到她家：妈妈、爸爸、Lily、Tom、Kate 姑姑、Ben 叔叔和表哥 Sam。

pages.en: Grandpa makes a big cake. Lily and Sam carry it to the table. Tom wants to eat the cake now, but Grandpa says, "Not yet!"
pages.zh: 爷爷做了一个大蛋糕。Lily 和 Sam 把它端到桌上。Tom 现在就想吃蛋糕，可是爷爷说：“还不行！”

pages.en: Everyone sings "Happy Birthday". Grandma is very happy. "I love my family," she says, and she gives everyone a big piece of cake.
pages.zh: 大家一起唱《生日快乐》。奶奶非常开心。“我爱我的家人。”她说，然后给每个人切了一大块蛋糕。

questions.q: Tom eats the cake before the song.
questions.zh: Tom 在唱歌之前就吃了蛋糕。

pages.en: On holiday, the family stays in a big hotel. Their room is on the tenth floor. "Let's take the lift," says Mum.
pages.zh: 度假时，一家人住在一家大酒店里。他们的房间在十楼。“我们坐电梯吧，”妈妈说。

pages.en: Tom loves the lift. He wants to go up and down all day! The lift stops on every floor. "Tom!" says Lily, and everyone laughs.
pages.zh: Tom 很喜欢电梯。他想一整天坐着电梯上上下下！电梯每层都停。“Tom！”Lily 说，大家都笑了。

pages.en: At last they get to their room. From the window, they can see the sea, a castle and the old town. "What a great building!" says Dad.
pages.zh: 终于到房间了。从窗户望出去，能看到大海、一座城堡和老城区。“这栋楼真棒！”爸爸说。

questions.q: The room is on the tenth floor.
What does Tom want to do in the lift?
questions.zh: Tom 想在电梯里做什么？
options: go up and down all day

questions.q: They can see a castle from the window.
questions.zh: 从窗户能看到一座城堡。

pages.en: It is Tom's birthday. Mum puts him next to the kitchen door with a ruler. "Stand up straight, Tom!" she says.
pages.zh: 今天是 Tom 的生日。妈妈让他站到厨房门边，拿着一把尺子。“站直了，Tom！”她说。

pages.en: "You are one metre and fifteen centimetres," says Mum. "That's five centimetres more than last year!"
pages.zh: “你有一米一十五厘米，”妈妈说，“比去年高了五厘米！”

pages.en: Then Dad finds out how heavy Max is. "Seven kilogrammes!" laughs Tom. Max just wants some birthday cake.
pages.zh: 接着爸爸给 Max 称了称有多重。“七公斤！”Tom 笑着说。Max 只想吃点生日蛋糕。

questions.q: Tom is taller than last year.
How many centimetres more is Tom?

pages.en: Lily has a penfriend called Ana. Ana lives in Spain with her parents and her little sister.
pages.zh: Lily 有一个笔友叫 Ana。Ana 和她的父母、妹妹住在西班牙。

pages.en: Today a letter comes from Ana. There is a photo in it. Ana and her sister are on the beach with their grandmother.
pages.zh: 今天 Ana 寄来一封信，里面有一张照片：Ana 和妹妹跟奶奶在海滩上。

pages.en: Lily writes back: "Dear Ana, this is my family. My brother is called Tom, and our dog is called Max. Please write again soon!"
pages.zh: Lily 回信写道：“亲爱的 Ana，这是我的家人。我弟弟叫 Tom，我们的狗叫 Max。请快点再给我写信！”

options: Ana, her sister and their grandmother

pages.en: Lily wants to paint a picture. She has red, yellow and blue paint. "I want more colours!" she says.
pages.zh: Lily 想画一幅画。她有红色、黄色和蓝色的颜料。“我想要更多颜色！”她说。

pages.en: Dad helps her. Yellow and blue make green. Red and yellow make orange. Red and blue make purple.
pages.zh: 爸爸帮她。黄色和蓝色调出绿色，红色和黄色调出橙色，红色和蓝色调出紫色。

pages.en: Now Lily has lots of colours. She paints an orange sun, a green tree and a purple flower. It's a beautiful picture!
pages.zh: 现在 Lily 有好多颜色了。她画了橙色的太阳、绿色的树和紫色的花。真是一幅漂亮的画！

questions.q: Lily has red, yellow and blue paint.
questions.zh: Lily 有红色、黄色和蓝色的颜料。

pages.en: Grandpa wants to read his book, but he can't find his glasses. "Where are my glasses?" he asks.
pages.zh: 爷爷想看书，可是找不到他的眼镜了。“我的眼镜在哪儿？”他问。

pages.en: Lily and Tom look everywhere. They look in his coat pocket, in his hat and under the chair. No glasses!
pages.zh: Lily 和 Tom 到处找。他们找了爷爷的外套口袋、帽子和椅子底下。没有眼镜！

pages.en: Then Lily looks in Max's bed. Grandpa's glasses are there! "Max!" everyone laughs. Grandpa says, "Thank you, Lily. Now I can read!"
pages.zh: 这时 Lily 往 Max 的狗窝里一看，爷爷的眼镜就在那儿！“Max！”大家都笑了。爷爷说：“谢谢你，Lily。现在我能看书了！”

pages.en: Lily and Mia go to the city centre with Mia's dad. There is a big market in the square. Mia stops to look at some earrings.
pages.zh: Lily 和 Mia 跟着 Mia 的爸爸去市中心。广场上有个大集市。Mia 停下来看一些耳环。

pages.en: When Lily turns round, Mia isn't there! Lily is worried. She looks round the corner and down the street, but she can't see Mia.
pages.zh: Lily 一转身，Mia 不见了！Lily 很着急。她看了看拐角，又看了看街道那头，可还是看不到 Mia。

pages.en: Then she hears, "Lily! I'm here!" Mia is in the middle of the square with a police officer. "Stay together!" says Mia's dad, and they all laugh.
pages.zh: 这时她听到：“Lily！我在这儿！”Mia 站在广场中间，身边有一位警察。“大家要待在一起！”Mia 的爸爸说，大家都笑了。

questions.q: They go to the city centre.
Where is Mia at the end?
options: in the middle of the square

questions.zh: Mia 和一位老师在一起。

pages.en: The family is at the airport. They are flying to Spain for their holiday. But Mum can't find her passport! "Oh no!" she says.
pages.zh: 一家人在机场。他们要坐飞机去西班牙度假。可是妈妈找不到她的护照了！“哎呀！”她说。

pages.en: Everyone looks in the bags and the suitcases. Lily checks Mum's coat. Tom looks under the seats. There is no passport.
pages.zh: 大家在包和行李箱里找。Lily 检查妈妈的外套，Tom 往座位底下看。都没有护照。

pages.en: Then Max's bag moves. Tom opens it, and there is the passport, under Max's toy! Everyone laughs. "Now we can go!" says Dad.
pages.zh: 这时 Max 的包动了一下。Tom 打开一看，护照就在 Max 的玩具下面！大家都笑了。“现在我们可以走了！”爸爸说。

questions.q: The family is going to Spain.

pages.en: Every Saturday there is a market in the square. Dad and Tom go to buy fruit and vegetables. The market is busy and noisy.
pages.zh: 每个星期六，广场上都有集市。爸爸和 Tom 去买水果和蔬菜。集市上人很多，很热闹。

pages.en: Tom wants some strawberries. "How much are they?" Dad asks. "Three pounds," says the man. "That's a good price!" says Dad.
pages.zh: Tom 想要草莓。“多少钱？”爸爸问。“三英镑，”那个男人说。“价格很公道！”爸爸说。

pages.en: At home, they make a big fruit salad for lunch. "Shopping at the market is fun," says Tom. "Can I come again next Saturday?"
pages.zh: 回到家，他们做了一大份水果沙拉当午饭。“在集市买东西真好玩，”Tom 说，“下个星期六我还能来吗？”

pages.en: Max is in the garden. He sees a small green frog near the water. The frog jumps. Max jumps too!
pages.zh: Max 在花园里。它看到水边有一只绿色的小青蛙。青蛙一跳，Max 也跟着跳！

pages.en: A butterfly flies over the flowers, and a bee is on a pink flower. Max wants to play, but the bee is busy.
pages.zh: 一只蝴蝶飞过花丛，一只蜜蜂停在粉红色的花上。Max 想玩，可是蜜蜂正忙着呢。

pages.en: Then the frog jumps into the water, and Max jumps in after it. Now Max is very wet! Lily laughs and gives him a big towel.
pages.zh: 接着青蛙跳进了水里，Max 也跟着跳了进去。现在 Max 浑身湿透了！Lily 笑着给它一条大毛巾。

questions.q: Max is dry at the end of the story.
questions.zh: 故事结尾时 Max 是干的。

pages.en: It's Mum's birthday. Lily and Tom want to make breakfast for her. They go into the kitchen very quietly.
pages.zh: 今天是妈妈的生日。Lily 和 Tom 想给她做早餐。他们悄悄地走进厨房。

pages.en: Tom makes toast. Lily gets the butter, the jam and some orange juice from the fridge. Then she puts some fruit in a bowl.
pages.zh: Tom 做吐司。Lily 从冰箱里拿出黄油、果酱和一些橙汁，然后在碗里放了一些水果。

pages.en: They put everything on a big plate and carry it upstairs. "Happy birthday, Mum!" Mum is very happy. "This is delicious. Thank you!"
pages.zh: 他们把所有东西放在一个大盘子上，端到楼上。“妈妈，生日快乐！”妈妈非常开心：“真好吃，谢谢你们！”

pages.en: Mum is a nurse at the hospital. Today Lily goes to work with her. Mum puts on her uniform and says hello to the other staff.
pages.zh: 妈妈是医院的护士。今天 Lily 跟她去上班。妈妈穿上制服，和其他同事打招呼。

pages.en: Mum checks a boy's temperature and gives an old man his medicine. She is very busy, but she is always kind to people.
pages.zh: 妈妈给一个男孩量体温，给一位老人送药。她很忙，但她对大家总是很和气。

pages.en: In the evening, Lily is tired but happy. "Your job is very important, Mum," she says. "I want to be a nurse too!"
pages.zh: 傍晚，Lily 累了，但很开心。“妈妈，你的工作非常重要，”她说，“我也想当护士！”

questions.q: Lily wants to be a nurse.

pages.en: Lily's family has a new house. It has a big garden, a red door and a garage for Dad's car.
pages.zh: Lily 家有了一栋新房子。房子有一个大花园、一扇红门，还有一个停爸爸车子的车库。

pages.en: Downstairs there is a kitchen, a living room and a small bathroom. Upstairs there are three bedrooms.
pages.zh: 楼下有厨房、客厅和一个小卫生间。楼上有三间卧室。

pages.en: Lily's bedroom is next to Tom's. It has a big window and a bookshelf. "I love my new room!" says Lily. Max loves it too. He sleeps on her bed!
pages.zh: Lily 的卧室在 Tom 的隔壁，有一扇大窗户和一个书架。“我好喜欢我的新房间！”Lily 说。Max 也很喜欢，它睡在 Lily 的床上！

questions.q: The new house has a garage.

questions.zh: Max 睡在 Tom 的床上。

pages.en: It's a sunny day, so the family has a picnic in the park. Mum brings sandwiches and fruit. Dad brings a bottle of lemonade.
pages.zh: 天气晴朗，一家人在公园野餐。妈妈带了三明治和水果，爸爸带了一瓶柠檬水。

pages.en: Tom eats a cheese sandwich and some strawberries. Lily wants a slice of chocolate cake, but Max wants it too!
pages.zh: Tom 吃了一个奶酪三明治和一些草莓。Lily 想吃一块巧克力蛋糕，可是 Max 也想吃！

pages.en: "No, Max! Chocolate is bad for dogs," says Lily. She gives him a dog biscuit. Max is happy, and Lily eats her cake.
pages.zh: “不行，Max！巧克力对狗不好。”Lily 说。她给了 Max 一块狗饼干。Max 很开心，Lily 吃了她的蛋糕。

questions.q: The family has a picnic on the beach.

questions.zh: Lily 给了 Max 什么？

pages.en: Lily has ten pounds from Grandpa. She goes shopping with Mum in the town centre. "What can I buy?" she thinks.
pages.zh: 爷爷给了 Lily 十英镑。她和妈妈去市中心购物。“我能买什么呢？”她想。

pages.en: In the toy shop, there is a big doll, but it is very expensive. In the bookshop, Lily finds a book about horses. It costs six pounds.
pages.zh: 在玩具店里，有一个大娃娃，可是太贵了。在书店里，Lily 找到一本关于马的书，价格是六英镑。

pages.en: Lily pays for the book, and the shop assistant gives her the change. Now she has four pounds. "I can buy a present for Tom too!" she says.
pages.zh: Lily 付钱买了书，店员找给她零钱。现在她还剩四英镑。“我还能给 Tom 买个礼物！”她说。

questions.q: Lily has four pounds at the end.
questions.zh: 最后 Lily 还剩四英镑。

pages.en: One morning, a postcard comes in the post. There is a picture of a beach on it. "It's from Sam!" says Lily.
pages.zh: 一天早上，邮差送来一张明信片，上面印着海滩的图片。“是 Sam 寄来的！”Lily 说。

pages.en: Sam is on holiday with his family. He writes: "The sea is warm and I can swim every day. I want to send you a letter too."
pages.zh: Sam 正和家人一起度假。他写道：“海水很暖和，我每天都能游泳。我还想给你们写封信。”

pages.en: Lily finds a pen and a nice card. She writes to Sam about Max and school. Then she puts it in an envelope and posts it.
pages.zh: Lily 找来一支笔和一张漂亮的卡片。她给 Sam 写了 Max 和学校的事，然后把卡片装进信封寄了出去。

questions.q: The postcard has a picture of a mountain.
questions.zh: 明信片上是一座山的图片。

questions.q: What can Sam do every day?

questions.zh: Lily 给 Sam 写了回信。

pages.en: In the morning it is sunny and warm. Lily and Tom want to play in the park, so Mum says, "Take your raincoats. It's going to rain."
pages.zh: 早上天气晴朗温暖。Lily 和 Tom 想去公园玩，妈妈说：“带上雨衣，要下雨了。”

pages.en: In the park, a big grey cloud comes. Then it starts to rain. The children put on their raincoats, but Max is very wet!
pages.zh: 在公园里，飘来一大片灰云，接着下起雨来。孩子们穿上了雨衣，可是 Max 被淋得湿透了！

pages.en: After the rain, the sun comes out again. Tom and Lily jump in the water on the path. Now everyone is wet, and they laugh all the way home!
pages.zh: 雨停后，太阳又出来了。Tom 和 Lily 在小路的水坑里跳来跳去。现在大家都湿透了，他们一路笑着回家！

questions.q: In the morning it is cold and windy.
The sun comes out after the rain.

pages.en: There is a concert at school tonight. Lily plays the piano and Mia plays the keyboard. Sam has a big drum.
pages.zh: 今晚学校有一场音乐会。Lily 弹钢琴，Mia 弹电子琴，Sam 打一面大鼓。

pages.en: Before the show, Lily feels nervous. "I can't remember the song!" she says. "You can do it," says Mia. "We practise every day."
pages.zh: 演出前，Lily 很紧张。“我想不起来那首歌了！”她说。“你能行的，”Mia 说，“我们每天都在练习。”

pages.en: The music starts and Lily's hands know the song. At the end, everyone shouts "Well done!" Mum, Dad and Tom are very happy.
pages.zh: 音乐响起，Lily 的手记得这首歌。演出结束时，大家都喊：“太棒了！”妈妈、爸爸和 Tom 都非常高兴。

questions.q: Lily feels nervous before the show.
questions.zh: 演出前 Lily 很紧张。

questions.q: Lily forgets the song in the concert.
questions.zh: Lily 在音乐会上忘了那首歌。

pages.en: It is Mia's birthday next week. Lily wants to give her a special present, but she doesn't have much money. She is worried.
pages.zh: 下周是 Mia 的生日。Lily 想送她一份特别的礼物，可是她没有多少钱。她很担心。

pages.en: "Make something," says Grandma. So Lily makes a card with flowers and a picture of Mia's cat. It is difficult, but she doesn't stop.
pages.zh: “自己做一样东西吧，”奶奶说。于是 Lily 做了一张贺卡，上面有花和 Mia 的猫。做起来很难，但她没有放弃。

pages.en: At the party, Mia opens the card. "It's beautiful! It's my favourite present!" she says. Lily feels very happy.
pages.zh: 在派对上，Mia 打开了贺卡。“太漂亮了！这是我最喜欢的礼物！”她说。Lily 觉得非常开心。

questions.q: Lily has a lot of money.

pages.en: On Monday, the teacher says, "We have a spelling test on Friday." Lily is a bit worried. Some words are very difficult.
pages.zh: 星期一，老师说：“我们星期五有拼写测验。”Lily 有点担心，有些单词很难。

pages.en: Every evening, Lily practises with Dad. He reads the words and she writes them. Max listens too. Lily remembers more and more words.
pages.zh: 每天晚上，Lily 都和爸爸一起练习。爸爸念单词，她来写。Max 也在旁边听。Lily 记住的单词越来越多。

pages.en: On Friday, Lily does the test. She knows all the words! The teacher gives her a good mark and a gold star.
pages.zh: 星期五，Lily 参加了测验。所有的单词她都会！老师给了她好分数和一颗金星。

pages.en: Today is sports day at Lily's school. There is a running race, a football game and a swimming competition.
pages.zh: 今天是 Lily 学校的运动会，有赛跑、足球赛和游泳比赛。

pages.en: Lily is in the running race. She runs very fast, but Mia is faster. Lily is second. "Well done!" says her teacher.
pages.zh: Lily 参加了赛跑。她跑得很快，可是 Mia 更快，Lily 得了第二名。“干得好！”老师说。

pages.en: Then Lily's team plays football. Lily scores the winning goal! Everyone is very happy, and her team gets the prize.
pages.zh: 接着 Lily 的队踢足球。Lily 踢进了制胜一球！大家都非常开心，她的队得了奖。

pages.en: One morning, Tom doesn't feel well. He has a cold and a high temperature. "No school today," says Mum. "Stay in bed and rest."
pages.zh: 一天早上，Tom 觉得不舒服。他感冒了，还发了高烧。“今天不去上学了，”妈妈说，“待在床上好好休息。”

pages.en: Mum takes Tom to see Dr Brown. The doctor checks his ears and his mouth. "Drink lots of water and take this medicine," she says.
pages.zh: 妈妈带 Tom 去看 Brown 医生。医生检查了他的耳朵和嘴巴。“多喝水，吃这个药，”她说。

pages.en: Lily reads Tom a story, and Max sits next to his bed. Three days later, Tom feels better. He runs in the garden with Max again!
pages.zh: Lily 给 Tom 读故事，Max 坐在他床边。三天后，Tom 好多了。他又和 Max 在花园里跑起来了！

questions.q: Tom goes to school with a cold.
Tom feels better after three days.
questions.zh: 三天后 Tom 好多了。

pages.en: It is a dark and noisy night. There is a terrible storm outside. Tom is afraid, so he goes to Lily's room.
pages.zh: 这是一个又黑又吵的夜晚。外面有一场可怕的暴风雨。Tom 很害怕，就去了 Lily 的房间。

pages.en: "Don't be afraid," says Lily. "Let's read a funny story." She reads to him, and Tom starts to laugh. Max comes in too.
pages.zh: “别害怕，”Lily 说，“我们来读一个好笑的故事吧。”她读给他听，Tom 开始笑了。Max 也进来了。

pages.en: In the morning, the sun is out. "I was brave last night," says Tom. "You were," says Lily, and they both laugh.
pages.zh: 早上，太阳出来了。“我昨晚很勇敢，”Tom 说。“你确实很勇敢，”Lily 说，两个人都笑了。

questions.q: Tom is sad in the morning.

pages.en: On Saturday, Lily and Tom go to Grandma's house by train. At the station, Dad buys the tickets from a machine. "Our train leaves from platform two," he says.
pages.zh: 星期六，Lily 和 Tom 坐火车去奶奶家。在车站，爸爸从售票机买了票。“我们的火车从二号站台出发，”他说。

pages.en: The train is late, so they wait on the platform. Then it comes! Lily sits by the window. She sees fields, cows and a long river.
pages.zh: 火车晚点了，他们就在站台上等。然后火车来了！Lily 坐在窗边，她看见了田野、奶牛和一条长长的河。

pages.en: After two hours, they arrive. Grandma is waiting at the station. She is very happy to see them. "Was the journey OK?" she asks. "It was great!" says Tom.
pages.zh: 两个小时后，他们到了。奶奶正在车站等着，见到他们非常高兴。“路上还好吗？”她问。“太棒了！”Tom 说。

questions.q: They go to Grandma's by bus.
questions.zh: 他们坐公共汽车去奶奶家。

questions.q: Where does Lily sit on the train?
questions.zh: Lily 在火车上坐在哪里？

pages.en: It is Grandma's birthday, but she lives far away. Lily has an idea. "Let's call her on the laptop!" she says.
pages.zh: 今天是奶奶的生日，可她住得很远。Lily 有个主意。“我们用笔记本电脑给她打电话吧！”她说。

pages.en: Dad types the password and clicks on Grandma's name. Soon Grandma's face is on the screen. "Hello, my dears!" she says.
pages.zh: 爸爸输入密码，点了奶奶的名字。很快奶奶的脸就出现在屏幕上。“你们好，亲爱的！”她说。

pages.en: Lily and Tom sing "Happy Birthday". Max wants to sing too! Grandma laughs. "This is the best present," she says.
pages.zh: Lily 和 Tom 唱起《生日快乐》。Max 也想跟着唱！奶奶笑了。“这是最好的礼物，”她说。

questions.zh: 他们怎么给奶奶打电话？

questions.q: Grandma likes the call very much.
questions.zh: 奶奶非常喜欢这次通话。

pages.en: Grandpa lives near a small village in the hills. One morning, he takes Lily, Tom and Max for a walk along the path by the river.
pages.zh: 爷爷住在山里一个小村子附近。一天早上，他带 Lily、Tom 和 Max 沿着河边的小路去散步。

pages.en: They walk through a field of cows and into a wood. Tom sees a rabbit, and Max wants to catch it. "No, Max!" says Lily.
pages.zh: 他们穿过一片有奶牛的田野，走进一片树林。Tom 看见了一只兔子，Max 想去抓它。“不行，Max！”Lily 说。

pages.en: At last they get to the village. They have lunch at a little cafe and look at the lake. "I love the countryside," says Lily.
pages.zh: 终于，他们到了村子。他们在一家小咖啡馆吃午饭，看着湖水。“我爱乡村，”Lily 说。

questions.q: Grandpa lives in a big city.
What does Tom see in the wood?
questions.zh: Tom 在树林里看到了什么？

questions.q: They have lunch at a cafe.
questions.zh: 他们在一家咖啡馆吃午饭。

pages.en: It's Sam's party today. Lily opens her cupboard. "What shall I wear?" she asks. She tries on a skirt, then a dress, then her jeans.
pages.zh: 今天是 Sam 的聚会。Lily 打开衣柜问：“我穿什么好呢？”她试了一条半身裙，又试了一条连衣裙，然后是她的牛仔裤。

pages.en: Tom is ready. He wears his lion costume! "It's not a costume party, Tom," Lily laughs. But Tom doesn't want to take it off.
pages.zh: Tom 已经准备好了，他穿着狮子服！“这不是化装聚会，Tom。”Lily 笑着说。可是 Tom 不想脱下来。

pages.en: In the end, Lily wears her blue dress and a pretty bracelet. Tom wears his lion costume. At the party, everyone loves Tom's costume!
pages.zh: 最后，Lily 穿上了蓝色连衣裙，戴了一条漂亮的手链。Tom 穿着他的狮子服。在聚会上，大家都很喜欢 Tom 的服装！

questions.q: Lily wears her jeans to the party.
questions.zh: Lily 穿着牛仔裤去参加聚会。

pages.en: At school, the teacher asks, "What job do you want when you are older?" Mia wants to be a singer. Sam wants to be a pilot.
pages.zh: 在学校，老师问：“你们长大后想做什么工作？”Mia 想当歌手，Sam 想当飞行员。

pages.en: Lily doesn't know. She likes drawing, animals and stories. At home she asks Dad, "What job is good for me?"
pages.zh: Lily 不知道。她喜欢画画、动物和故事。回到家，她问爸爸：“什么工作适合我？”

pages.en: "You can be a writer and an artist," says Dad. "You can write and draw books about animals!" Lily laughs. "That's a great idea!"
pages.zh: “你可以当作家，也可以当画家，”爸爸说，“你可以写书、画书，讲动物的故事！”Lily 笑了起来：“好主意！”

questions.q: Sam wants to be a pilot.
Who does Lily ask at home?
Lily wants to write books about cars.
questions.zh: Lily 想写关于汽车的书。

pages.en: It's time for Max's dinner, but where is he? Lily looks in the kitchen. He isn't there.
pages.zh: 到 Max 吃晚饭的时间了，可是它在哪儿呢？Lily 去厨房找，它不在那儿。

pages.en: Tom looks under the sofa and behind the curtains in the living room. He opens the cupboard. No Max!
pages.zh: Tom 在客厅的沙发底下、窗帘后面找，又打开柜子。没有 Max！

pages.en: Then they hear a noise upstairs. Max is in the bathroom, in the bath! He wants to play with Tom's yellow duck.
pages.zh: 这时他们听到楼上有动静。Max 在卫生间里，就在浴缸里！它想玩 Tom 的黄色小鸭子。

questions.q: Max wants to play with a yellow duck.
questions.zh: Max 想玩一只黄色小鸭子。

pages.en: Today is Around the World Day at school. Every class has a country. Lily's class has Italy, and Mia's class has Japan.
pages.zh: 今天是学校的“环游世界日”。每个班都有一个国家。Lily 班上是意大利，Mia 班上是日本。

pages.en: Lily makes a pizza and learns some Italian words. Mia wears Japanese clothes. Sam's class has Brazil, and they play football.
pages.zh: Lily 做了一个披萨，还学了几个意大利语单词。Mia 穿着日本的传统服装。Sam 班上是巴西，他们踢起了足球。

pages.en: At the end of the day, Lily looks at the big map of the world. "I want to visit every country," she says.
pages.zh: 一天结束时，Lily 看着那张大大的世界地图。“我想去每一个国家，”她说。

questions.q: Which country does Lily's class have?

questions.zh: Sam 班上下了国际象棋。

pages.en: On Saturday, Lily and Dad go to the zoo. First, they see a big lion. The lion is sleeping on a rock.
pages.zh: 星期六，Lily 和爸爸去动物园。他们先看到一头大狮子。狮子正在一块岩石上睡觉。

pages.en: Next, they see a tall giraffe and a grey elephant. The giraffe eats from the top of a tree. The elephant drinks water with its long nose.
pages.zh: 接着，他们看到一只高高的长颈鹿和一头灰色的大象。长颈鹿吃树顶上的叶子，大象用长鼻子喝水。

pages.en: Then Lily sees a funny monkey with a banana. "Can I have a banana too?" asks Lily. Dad laughs. "Let's go to the cafe!"
pages.zh: 然后 Lily 看到一只拿着香蕉的滑稽猴子。“我也能吃根香蕉吗？”Lily 问。爸爸笑了：“我们去咖啡馆吧！”

questions.q: Lily goes to the zoo with Mum.
questions.zh: Lily 和妈妈去了动物园。
